dict.string: Murmur reads upcoming events from calendars on this Mac to prepare meeting reminders. It does not edit your calendars or start recording automatically.
Murmur listens to your microphone while you dictate or explicitly run local meeting capture.
When you start a meeting recording, Murmur captures your Mac’s system audio for local transcription. It never records your screen.
Murmur watches for your configured dictation shortcut (Right ⌘ by default).
Murmur opens the Privacy & Security pane when you ask and controls output volume when you enable Mute system audio while dictating.
